label: Silence
description: Persistent mute across reconnects (separate from essentials.py's session-only !mute).

commands.name: silence
commands.description: Mutes a player persistently for the given length.

commands.name: unsilence
commands.description: Removes a persistent mute from a player.

commands.name: checksilence
commands.description: Checks whether a player is currently silenced.
